title: Reverse Accountability Search Index
mission: Matrix Reprogrammed is a public accountability system where anyone can search a consequence, trace it backwards through decisions, authority and money, follow the unanswered questions, and return to see what actually happened.
publicPromise: Search the consequence. Trace the power. Follow the outcome.
operatingRule: A match is a route into potentially relevant public records. It is not proof that a named person or institution caused the consequence, exercised authority or benefited.
